name: list_runs
description: List all runs for a project. Use this tool when you need to search for a run or list all runs for a project.

projectRef.description: The trigger.dev project ref, starts with proj_. We will attempt to automatically detect the project ref if running inside a directory that includes a trigger.config.ts file, or if you pass the --project-ref option to the MCP server.

configPath.description: The path to the trigger.config.ts file. Only used when the trigger.config.ts file is not at the root dir (like in a monorepo setup). If not provided, we will try to find the config file in the current working directory

environment.description: The environment to get tasks for

branch.description: The branch to get tasks for, only used for preview environments

cursor.description: The cursor to use for pagination, starts with run_

limit.description: The number of runs to list in a single page. Up to 100

status.description: Filter for runs with this run status

taskIdentifier.description: Filter for runs that match this task identifier

version.description: Filter for runs that match this version, e.g. 20250808.3

tag.description: Filter for runs that include this tag

from.description: Filter for runs created after this ISO 8601 timestamp

to.description: Filter for runs created before this ISO 8601 timestamp

period.description: Filter for runs created in the last N time period. e.g. 7d, 30d, 365d

machine.description: Filter for runs that match this machine preset
